search.queryText:
_sourceCategory = Labs/AWS/CloudTrail s3.amazonaws.com 
| json "eventSource", "eventName", "sourceIPAddress", "errorCode" nodrop 
| where isBlank(errorCode) and eventSource="s3.amazonaws.com" 
| if(isPublicIP(sourceIPAddress) and ((eventName matches "Put*") or (eventName matches "Create*") or (eventName matches "Delete*") or (eventName matches "Update*")), 1 ,0) as eventNotRead 
| sum(eventNotRead) as count 
| "S3_CrudBucketsFromPublicIp" as benchmarkname 
| "EventCount" as type 
| fillmissing values("S3_CrudBucketsFromPublicIp") in benchmarkname, values("EventCount") in type 
| toInt(count) as count
